compatibility: Detect the installed PrestaShop generation/version before applying conventions.
Do not assume module APIs, Symfony integration, hooks, or override behavior are identical across versions.
rules: Prefer modules, hooks, services, and documented override mechanisms over core edits.
Treat existing overrides and core changes as brownfield facts that require impact analysis.
Preserve module install/uninstall/upgrade lifecycle, translations, database changes, and packaging rules.
verification: Verify module installation and upgrade paths.
Verify back-office and front-office behavior separately when both are affected.
